									<h3>Are there any contracts or commitments?</h3>
					<div class="">
						<p>No, there are no contracts or commitments. With SocialPilot, you can cancel your account anytime – irrespective of the plan you’ve chosen.</p>
					</div>
									<h3>What payment options do you offer?</h3>
					<div class="">
						<p>When using SocialPilot, you’ll be required to pay in US dollars. We accept payments made with credit cards and PayPal.</p>
					</div>
									<h3>Can I change my plan later?</h3>
					<div class="">
						<p>Yes, you can switch your plans or downgrade/upgrade your subscription anytime you want. You can also Pause your subscription if you don’t need your account for a certain time period.</p>
					</div>
									<h3>What kind of support do you offer?</h3>
					<div class="">
						<p>SocialPilot provides you with reliable customer support across different channels – mail, chat, mobile app and call (scheduled as per your convenience).</p>
					</div>
									<h3>Can users under the Agency+ plan in SocialPilot use Slack integration?</h3>
					<div class="">
						<p>SocialPilot users under any plan, including the Agency+ plan can integrate their Slack workspaces into the SocialPilot accounts. But people who are using white label solutions will not be able to use Slack integration with SocialPilot. Using white label changes the user experience of SocialPilot, replacing the logo of the tool with the user's brand. But such customization is not possible on Slack. Hence to preserve the customized branding experience of white label features, Slack integrations for these users have been made unavailable.</p>

Are there any contracts or commitments?
No, there are no contracts or commitments. With SocialPilot, you can cancel your account anytime – irrespective of the plan you’ve chosen.
What payment options do you offer?
When using SocialPilot, you’ll be required to pay in US dollars. We accept payments made with credit cards and PayPal.
Can I change my plan later?
Yes, you can switch your plans or downgrade/upgrade your subscription anytime you want. You can also Pause your subscription if you don’t need your account for a certain time period.
What kind of support do you offer?
SocialPilot provides you with reliable customer support across different channels – mail, chat, mobile app and call (scheduled as per your convenience).
Can users under the Agency+ plan in SocialPilot use Slack integration?
SocialPilot users under any plan, including the Agency+ plan can integrate their Slack workspaces into the SocialPilot accounts. But people who are using white label solutions will not be able to use Slack integration with SocialPilot. Using white label changes the user experience of SocialPilot, replacing the logo of the tool with the user's brand. But such customization is not possible on Slack. Hence to preserve the customized branding experience of white label features, Slack integrations for these users have been made unavailable.
